claims.text: Peds dosing (viscous lidocaine label): > 3 y w normal lean body mass and development: max dose set by wt or age, eg, a 5-y-old weighing 50 lb → ≤ 75–100 mg (3.7–5 mL);
claims.quote: For children over 3 years of age who have a normal lean body mass and normal body development, the maximum dose is determined by the child’s weight or age. For example: in a child of 5 years weighing 50 lbs., the dose of lidocaine should not exceed 75 to 100 mg (3.7 to 5 mL of lidocaine).

claims.text: infants and < 3 y: measure accurately, ≤ 1.2 mL applied to the area w a cotton-tipped applicator;
claims.quote: For infants and in children under 3 years of age, the solution should be accurately measured and no more than 1.2 mL be applied to the immediate area with a cotton-tipped applicator.

claims.text: wait ≥ 3 h between doses; max four doses in 12 h.
claims.quote: Wait at least 3 hours before giving the next dose; a maximum of four doses may be given in a 12-hour period.
